arxiv-2009-05756.title: THE 2017 SEPTEMBER 6 FLARE: RADIO BURSTS AND PULSATIONS IN THE 22-5000 MHz RANGE AND ASSOCIATED PHENOMENA
arxiv-2009-05756.creator: Marian Karlický, Ján Rybák
arxiv-2009-05756.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Marian Karlický, Ján Rybák. For the 2017 September 6 flare (SOL2017-Sep-06T11:53) we present not only unusual radio bursts, but also their interesting time association with the other flare phenomena observed in EUV, white-light, X-ray, and γ \gamma -ray emissions. Using our new method based on wavelets we found quasi-periodic pulsations (QPPs) in several locations of the whole time-frequency domain of the analyzed radio spectrum (11:55–12:07 UT and 22–5000 MHz).

arxiv-2302-02843.title: Development of energy calibration and data analysis systems for the NUCLEUS experiment.
arxiv-2302-02843.creator: Giorgio Del Castello
arxiv-2302-02843.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Giorgio Del Castello. Coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering (CE ν \nu NS) opens new approaches for the search of new physics beyond the Standard Model at low energies. The NUCLEUS experiment, situated at the Chooz nuclear power plant, aims to use the intense antineutrino flux produced from the reactor cores (with maximum neutrino energy of the MeV order) to perform high precision measurements of the CE ν \nu NS cross-section via gram-scale ultra-low threshold cryogenic detectors.

arxiv-2305-17077.title: Learning and Leveraging Verifiers to Improve Planning Capabilities of Pre-trained Language Models
arxiv-2305-17077.creator: Daman Arora, Subbarao Kambhampati
arxiv-2305-17077.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Daman Arora, Subbarao Kambhampati. There have been wide spread claims in the literature about the emergent reasoning capabilities of Pretrained Large Language Models. However, recent studies, have found that their ability to plan remains questionable. Through our experiments using GPT-2, we empirically demonstrate that the performance of a finetuned baseline remains poor because it violates pre-conditions of actions in the plans that it generates.

arxiv-2401-06018.title: Implications of comprehensive nuclear and astrophysics data on the equations of state of neutron star matter
arxiv-2401-06018.creator: Sk Md Adil Imam 1,2, Tuhin Malik 3, Constança Providência 3, B. K. Agrawal 1,2,3
arxiv-2401-06018.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sk Md Adil Imam 1,2, Tuhin Malik 3, Constança Providência 3, B. K. Agrawal 1,2,3. The equations of state (EoSs) governing neutron star (NS) matter obtained for both non-relativistic and relativistic mean-field models are systematically confronted with a diverse set of terrestrial data and astrophysical observations within the Bayesian framework.

arxiv-2403-08869.title: ALMA reveals a compact and massive molecular outflow driven by the young AGN in a nearby ULIRG 2023 ALMA reveals a compact and massive molecular outflow driven by the young AGN in a nearby ULIRG – B
arxiv-2403-08869.creator: Luke R. Holden, Clive N. Tadhunter, Anelise Audibert, Tom Oosterloo, Cristina Ramos Almeida, Raffaella Morganti, Miguel Pereira-Santaella, Isabella Lamperti
arxiv-2403-08869.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Luke R. Holden, Clive N. Tadhunter, Anelise Audibert, Tom Oosterloo, Cristina Ramos Almeida, Raffaella Morganti, Miguel Pereira-Santaella, Isabella Lamperti. The ultra luminous infrared galaxy (ULIRG) F13451+1232 is an excellent example of a galaxy merger in the early stages of active galactic nucleus (AGN) activity, a phase in which AGN-driven outflows are expected to be particularly important.

arxiv-2410-05453.title: Interconnected Kingdoms: Comparing ‘A Song of Ice and Fire’ Adaptations Across Media Using Complex Networks
arxiv-2410-05453.creator: Arthur Amalvy, Madeleine Janickyj, Shane Mannion, Pádraig MacCarron, Vincent Labatut
arxiv-2410-05453.description: Abstract In this article, we propose and apply a method to compare adaptations of the same story across different media. We tackle this task by modelling such adaptations through character networks. We compare them by leveraging two concepts at the core of storytelling: the characters involved, and the dynamics of the story.

arxiv-2411-06116.title: Supernotes: Driving Consensus in Crowd-Sourced Fact-Checking Conference: ArXiv; pre-print; 2024
arxiv-2411-06116.creator: Soham De, Michiel A. Bakker, Jay Baxter, Martin Saveski
arxiv-2411-06116.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Soham De, Michiel A. Bakker, Jay Baxter, Martin Saveski. X’s Community Notes, a crowd-sourced fact-checking system, allows users to annotate potentially misleading posts. Notes rated as helpful by a diverse set of users are prominently displayed below the original post.

arxiv-2502-16655.title: Teaching Loop Testing to Young Learners with the Code Critters Mutation Testing Game
arxiv-2502-16655.creator: Philipp Straubinger, Lena Bloch, Gordon Fraser
arxiv-2502-16655.description: Abstract Serious games can teach essential coding and testing concepts even to younger audiences. In the Code Critters game critters execute short snippets of block-based code while traversing the game map, and players position magical portals (akin to test oracles) at locations (akin to test inputs) to distinguish between critters executing correct code from those who execute faulty code.

arxiv-2503-04381.title: TRACT: Regression-Aware Fine-tuning Meets Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for LLM-as-a-Judge
arxiv-2503-04381.creator: Cheng-Han Chiang, Hung-yi Lee, Michal Lukasik
arxiv-2503-04381.description: Abstract The LLM-as-a-judge paradigm uses large language models (LLMs) for automated text evaluation, which assigns a score to the text based on some scoring rubrics. Existing methods for LLM-as-a-judge use cross-entropy (CE) loss for fine-tuning, which neglects the numeric nature of score prediction.

arxiv-2506-21305.title: Gravity Duality of Networks
arxiv-2506-21305.creator: Yu Guo, Rong-Xin Miao
arxiv-2506-21305.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yu Guo, Rong-Xin Miao. The network has been attracting increasing attention for its role in driving the artificial intelligence revolution and enabling profound insights into gravity. This paper investigates the gravity dual of the conformal field theory defined on a network (AdS/NCFT). A typical network, consisting of edges and nodes, is dual to a spacetime with branches and connecting branes, which we refer to as Net-branes.

pmc-11586912.title: A Nonparametric Global Win Probability Approach to the Analysis and Sizing of Randomized Controlled Trials With Multiple Endpoints of Different Scales and Missing Data: Beyond O'Brien–Wei–Lachin
pmc-11586912.creator: Guangyong Zou, Lily Zou
pmc-11586912.description: Multiple primary endpoints are commonly used in randomized controlled trials to assess treatment effects. When the endpoints are measured on different scales, the O'Brien rank‐sum test or the Wei–Lachin test for stochastic ordering may be used for hypothesis testing. However, the O'Brien–Wei–Lachin (OWL) approach is unable to handle missing data and adjust for baseline measurements.

pmc-11715925.title: Effect of incident stroke on the risk of dementia over 10 years of follow‐up in a cohort of Asian American and White older adults in Northern California
pmc-11715925.creator: L Paloma Rojas‐Saunero, Yixuan Zhou, Eleanor Hayes‐Larson, Yingyan Wu, Roch A Nianogo, Rachel A Whitmer, Paola Gilsanz, Holly C Elser, Elizabeth Rose Mayeda

Previous work has not accounted for time‐varying covariates that could increase risk of stroke and dementia over time, and there has been very limited evidence on the effect in Asian Americans.

pmc-12414155.title: Infant behavioural assessment and intervention program to support neurodevelopmental outcome of very preterm infants at two years corrected age: a cluster randomised controlled trial study protocol
pmc-12414155.creator: Meghan Smith, Pierre Kuhn, Gerard Thiriez, Thierry Debillon, Valérie Datin-Dorrière, Bertrand Leboucher, Delphine Mitanchez, Emmanuelle Courtois-Communier, Jacques Sizun, Jean-Michel Roué
pmc-12414155.description: IntroductionPreterm infants are at risk of developmental impairment, especially those born before 33 weeks gestational age. Many studies have shown a positive impact of early interventions on medical outcomes during hospitalisation, long-term cognitive development and parental anxiety. Infant Behavioral Assessment and Intervention Program (IBAIP) has shown positive effects on cognitive development but also on motor impairment in a Dutch cohort.

pmc-12523406.title: Salivary Molecular Testing for Periodontal Pathogen Monitoring: Clinical Performance of Flexible RT-PCR Platforms in Preventive Care Settings
pmc-12523406.creator: Fabiana D’Urso, Federica Paladini, Mauro Pollini, Francesco Broccolo, Gianna Dipalma
pmc-12523406.description: Objective: This study aimed to validate the clinical utility of a salivary molecular platform (Oral Predict®) for periodontal pathogen detection across preventive, therapeutic, and maintenance settings. Methods: A longitudinal randomized study was conducted involving 78 adults who provided saliva samples at baseline, one month, and three months after professional dental hygiene.

pmc-12552914.title: The beneficial effect of propolis during an eight-weeks of resistance training on TNF-α and IL-6 genes expression in the kidney tissue of female Wistar rats undergoing testosterone enanthate consumption
pmc-12552914.creator: Khadijeh Molaei, Sanaz Mirzayan Shanjani, Ali Gorzi, Yaser Kazemzadeh, Abdolali Banaeifar
pmc-12552914.description: This study investigated the potential benefits of propolis in mitigating the adverse effects of testosterone enanthate on the gene expression levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines, tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α), and interleukin-6 (IL-6) in the kidney tissue of female Wistar rats undergoing resistance training.

pmc-12583637.title: Application of multipoint flexible optical probe for intra-abdominal visceral perfusion monitoring
pmc-12583637.creator: Toshio Horiuchi, Atsushi Miki, Yoko Tomioka, Yasunaru Sakuma, Takafumi Ohmiya, Takumi Teratani, Kazuhiro Endo, Itsuro Saito, Wataru Nishimura, Mutsumi Okazaki, Hironori Yamaguchi, Masaki Sekino
pmc-12583637.description: The maintenance of postoperative blood flow is essential to ensure the optimal condition of transplanted organs. Further, early detection of circulatory disturbances is necessary to prevent graft failure, but is complicated by the closed space after surgery. Continuous and prompt inspection of organ blood flow can help to ensure post-operative blood flow monitoring.

pmc-12587790.title: Age-adjusted visceral adiposity index as a predictor of chronic kidney disease: insights from NHANES 2007–2018
pmc-12587790.creator: Bing Yan, Rongrong Yuan, Lianghong Yin, Shengling Huang
pmc-12587790.description: The age-adjusted visceral adiposity index (AVAI) is a novel marker reflecting visceral fat-related metabolic risk. However, its relationship with chronic kidney disease (CKD) remains unclear. This study aims to evaluate the association between AVAI and CKD prevalence in U.S. adults.

pmc-12809966.title: Establishment of a novel brainstem ischemic dysphagia model: single-cell sequencing reveals the molecular mechanisms underlying mPES intervention
pmc-12809966.creator: Yueqin Tian, Qianqian Wang, Jiahui Hu, Jia Qiao, Chao Li, Xiangxiang Zhang, Tingting Jiang, Nenggui Xu, Hongmei Wen, Zulin Dou, Qiuping Ye
pmc-12809966.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectivePrevious animal models of post-stroke dysphagia (PSD) have limitations—these models are primarily induced by cortical strokes. Compared to cortical strokes, brainstem strokes are more likely to cause dysphagia, and the pathological mechanisms underlying dysphagia differ by focal infarction location. This study aimed to create a novel rat dysphagia model via brainstem ischemia (BSI) and explore modified pharyngeal electrical stimulation (mPES) therapy.MethodsRat brainstem ischemia was induced by photochemical embolization, confirmed by MRI and pathology.

pmc-12812841.title: Global initiative for childhood six-indexed cancers: how are we faring in Nigeria?
pmc-12812841.creator: Motunrayo Oluwabukola Adekunle, Aisha Musa, Chioma Ginika, Chisom Nri-Ezedii, Uduak Offiong, Hauwa Yusuf, Peter Odion Ubuane, Adewunmi Oyesakin, Ijeoma Nnenna Diaku-Akinwumi, Adaorah Onyiaorah
pmc-12812841.description: BackgroundWHO's Global Initiative for Childhood Cancer (GICC) aims to increase global survival of childhood cancers to 60% by the year 2030 with a focus on six index cancers. However, there is no nationally representative epidemiologic data on these index cancers in Nigeria.AimTo describe the distribution, outcomes and determinants of GICC six-indexed cancer in Nigeria.

pmc-13476763.title: Long-term outcomes of childhood encephalitis in Australia: burden and predictors from the Australian childhood encephalitis (ACE) prospective multicentre cohort
pmc-13476763.creator: Gautam J. Rao, Russell C. Dale, Rebecca Burrell, Luis Furuya-Kanamori, Katherine Phan, Christopher C. Blyth, Jim P. Buttery, Julia E. Clark, Nigel W. Crawford, Helen S. pmc-13476763.description: SummaryBackgroundEncephalitis is inflammation of the brain parenchyma with heterogenous aetiology and presentation. In children, it often leads to short-term residual neurological deficits, however clinical predictors of adverse long-term outcome are not fully understood.MethodsCases of suspected encephalitis, in children aged 0 to <15 years, were actively identified from five paediatric hospitals in Australia, from March 2014 to June 2018.

pmc-13713998.title: Relationship trust in individuals with multiple sclerosis: a network analysis approach
pmc-13713998.creator: Cristiana Văcăraș, Larisa Cristina Ioana Tînc, Veronica Văcăraș, Răzvan Predatu, Cătălina Crișan, Dafin F Mureșanu, Vitalie Văcăraș

Analyses were conducted using RStudio and JASP.
